acceptance.assertion: A hermetic regression simulates deploy generation N upgrading to N+1 where N+1 changes verifier/runtime contracts and proves the N+1 deploy implementation is staged and selected before N+1-specific target verification; the test performs no real Heim-PC service or installed-runtime mutation.

The handoff remains exact reviewed-head/hash/preimage bound, rejects unsafe path identity or unexpected bytes fail-closed, and preserves rollback semantics when the staged next-generation deployer or target validation fails.
Repository tests prove that after a successful simulated N→N+1 convergence, an unchanged second deploy creates no release, performs no service action, and reports the same exact runtime head.

Repository artifacts and documentation expose all exact inputs, preflight evidence, rollback data and expected receipts needed by dependent live task AUDIO-CONTROL-PLANE-V1-T035; T034 itself performs and claims no host or service mutation.

Implementation, full diff, self-review, material external reviews, local relevant tests and required GitHub checks are bound to the same published head; open material review findings or red checks block merge.

approval.note: Repository implementation, tests, PR and merge only. No service start/stop/restart, installed-file replacement, deploy-timer mutation or other Heim-PC runtime effect belongs to T034.

goal: Implement and prove in the audio repository a cross-generation self-deploy handoff that lets reviewed deploy generation N+1 replace N's deploy logic before N+1-specific runtime verification is evaluated, without weakening exact-head/hash/preimage binding, fail-closed validation or rollback. This task is repository-only and does not authorize live service or host mutation.

metadata.discovery: Post-merge runtime verification of audio PR #89 exposed a self-deploy bootstrap deadlock: the old installed deploy verifier expected 7 remote effects, rejected the new correct 10-effect bridge contract, and rolled back every minute. PR #90 fixed the immediate allowlist drift and added parity CI, but escaping the already-installed old generation still required one controlled hash-bound bootstrap.
does_not_establish: Permission to mutate Heim-PC services or installed runtime
A need to weaken runtime verification

review_correction.reason: P1 correctly found that the original T034 live acceptance exceeded its repo.audio reservation and repository_mutation approval.
review_correction.resolution: T034 is repository-only; live convergence is split into T035 with host/service scope and break-glass runtime_mutation approval.

title: Make Audiozentrale self-deploy bootstrap-safe across deploy-contract changes
